title: The text discusses the ongoing conflict in Guinea-Bissau, where fighting has erupted between government forces and rebels led by former armed forces chief Ansumane Mane. Thousands of refugees are fleeing the violence, with reports of casualties, including drownings while attempting to escape by boat. The situation has prompted evacuations of foreign diplomatic staff and damage to key infrastructure. Meanwhile, peace talks are taking place in Burundi, aiming to address the political crisis following a coup. Additionally, the International Court of Justice is set to rule on a border dispute between Nigeria and Cameroon over the oil-rich Bakassi peninsula, amidst concerns about the impact of a recent European Court ruling on aid funding.
